name: session-hud
description: Ambient HUD for running many Claude Code sessions at once: a tab per chat, and a meter for what the session window has left.

plugins.name: claude-session-hud
plugins.description: An ambient heads-up display for running many Claude Code sessions at once. Every open chat gets a persistent, distinctly-coloured tab showing its live state - working, done, asking you a question, or blocked on you - named by Claude for the area of work it covers. Click one to jump straight to that chat's tab in the right window. A meter above the stack shows how much of your 5-hour session window you have spent, coloured by whether your current burn will run it out before it resets, with a detail panel for the burn rate, tokens a minute, which chat is spending them, and the shape of the session so far. Tabs can be reordered, stowed, and slid off the screen entirely from a handle at the edge. Tabs, meter and tint are Windows; the 'a session needs you' notification is cross-platform.
